title: [RFC] Multi-modal Generation RL 2026Q2 Roadmap
bodyExcerpt:
**Multi-modal generation rl support has been migrated to [verl-project/verl-omni](https://github.com/verl-project/verl-omni)**

### 🛠 Architecture

#### Rollout Engine
- vLLM-Omni enhancement @zhtmike @knlnguyen1802 
  - [x] Cross-request batching verification  https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-omni/pull/1593
  - [x] TP support (weight sync) https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/5809
  - [ ] DP support  @zhtmike 
  - [ ] abort/resume api verification https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-omni/pull/1156 @AndyZhou952 
  - [ ] diffusers backend support   🙋
  - [x] prompt embedding caching @knlnguyen1802 
  - [ ] fp8 rollout verification [P1]  🙋
  - [ ] EPDG disaggregation (tbc)

#### Trainer
- [ ] diffusers FSDP trainer
  - [ ] SP support @zhtmike 
- [ ] VeOmni diffusion trainer as default
  - [ ] Parallelism verificaiton: FSDP + SP (QwenImage), EP (HunyuanImage-3.0)
  - [ ] diffusers backend support
- [ ] Support full-model fine-tuning  🙋
- [ ] FlopsCounter for diffusion models
- [ ] Fully async trainer for diffusion models, verification

#### Reward
- [ ] multi-reward training support (MultiRewardManager)

### 🎨 Model & Algorithm Supports
- Image Gen (X2I)
  - [ ] QwenImage
     - [x] FlowGRPO-fast (Dense DiT) [P0]  
     - [ ] GPRO-Guard
  - [ ] HunyuanImage 3.0 + MixGRPO/SRPO (MoE DiT)
  - [ ] GLM-Image + FlowGRPO (AR + Diffusion)  🙋
- Video Gen (X2V)
  - [ ] Wan2.1/Wan2.2 + FlowGRPO   [P0]    @wtomin
  - [ ] DanceGRPO based on vLLM-Omni rollouter + VeOmni trainer @Kirrito-k423  https://github.com/verl-project/verl/issues/5916
- Audio Gen (X2A)
  - [ ] PrismAudio (V2A task, Fast-GRPO)  (tbc)
- Unified Und. & Gen. (UMM)
  - [ ] BAGEL + FlowGRPO   [P0]   @princepride 
- Omni-models
  - [ ] Qwen3Omni  [High Priority]
    - [ ] Thinker + GSPO @qinganrice

### 📖 Documentation

- [x] How to add a model with vLLM-Omni backend @wtomin
